title: Tech Note: 4D Record Locking and ORDA Entity Locking
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Both locking systems described are still fully current in 4D: classic pessimistic table/record locking (READ ONLY/READ WRITE, Locked, LOCKED BY) remains unchanged, and ORDA entity locking (entity.lock()/unlock(), stamp-based optimistic locking via entity.save(), and dk auto merge) is the standard approach for ORDA-based apps and has only been extended with more options since.
related_updates: ORDA entity locking has continued to mature with additional save() options and conflict-resolution flags in later 4D versions
classic 4D locking commands remain unchanged and fully supported for non-ORDA/legacy code
